en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of an ornate colonnaded spa pavilion with arches and decorative woodwork, a clock above the central entrance and people strolling in front. Behind it rises a square tower with a bulbous onion dome set against a wooded hillside. The bottom margin contains German text identifying the scene as the spa town Karlsbad with its market spring and city tower.
